hero.headline: Photo Gallery
hero.subheadline: Explore moments from ORP-5 through images captured during conference sessions, exhibitions, field visits, and interactions.

intro.title: Moments from ORP-5
intro.description: This gallery presents visual highlights from the 5ᵗʰ International Conference on Organic and Natural Rice Production Systems (ORP-5), capturing academic sessions, exhibitions, field visits, and interactions among participants.

footerCta.headline: Relive Moments from ORP-5
footerCta.subheadline: Browse images and media resources related to conference sessions, exhibitions, and field visits from the 5ᵗʰ International Conference on Organic and Natural Rice Production Systems (ORP-5).
